bundle.shortDescription: Local visual and voice companion for Claude Code skills
bundle.longDescription: Candice is the face, voice, ears, and lightweight user interface for the active Claude Code session and the invoked skill — which remain the brain, rules, memory, and source of truth. Speech is local and offline (whisper.cpp STT, Kokoro TTS); no per-use cloud cost.
